gloss: one point; one item; a single spot

definitions.explanation: A single point in a game, competition, or test.
A single item, especially artwork or merchandise.
Focusing on or referring to a single location or aspect.

notes:
{一点|いってん} has multiple meanings related to "one point" or "one item."

SCORE USAGE (Sense 1):
- {一点|いってん}⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: one-point difference
- {一点|いってん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to score one point
- {先制|せんせい}{一点|いってん}: first point

ITEM USAGE (Sense 2):
- {一点|いってん}もの: one-of-a-kind item
- {一点|いってん}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: limited to one item
- ⟦お{一人|ひとり}{様|さま}→お一人様：10274_ohitorisama⟧{一点|いってん}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: one item per customer

FOCUS USAGE (Sense 3):
- {一点|いってん}⟦{集中|しゅうちゅう}→集中：03212_shuuchuu⟧: concentrated on one point
- {一点|いってん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曇|くも}り→曇り：02875_kumori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧: without a single cloud (perfect)
